description: Use when the user shares their résumé (or CV) text and wants to see real, currently open jobs that fit it. Sends the résumé text to Seeker (seekerscore.com), which compares it with its live job postings and returns the top 5 matches with title, company, location, a fit label, a short reason and the posting link, plus a link to see all matches on Seeker. Fit labels describe how well the résumé matches each posting; they are not predictions of interviews or hiring. Matching can take up to a minute.

resume_text.description: The full plain text of the user's résumé, 200 to 50000 characters. Phone number and home address can be left out.

name: match_resume
title: Match résumé to live jobs
